what: Evaluation battery for filter selection and composition. Each case fixes, BEFORE any query is run: the question, its facets with the role the contract expects for each one, and a reference set of studies INCLUDED by an independent systematic review (read in its full text, resolved to PMIDs by first author and year against the review's own linked citations). Retention is measured mechanically: a reference PMID is in the result or it is not.
what_it_does_not_measure: What a conversational surface actually does. The strategies are composed by hand from the text of each contract version: they measure what the contract prescribes or permits, not whether a model follows it. Comparing risk_under_1_10 with contract_1_11 shows what an ambiguity could cost, not a causal superiority of one contract; conformant_1_10 is the fairer comparison. Precision is reported only as result counts.

strategy_versions.risk_under_1_10: A composition that contract 1.10.0 PERMITTED through an ambiguity, without prescribing it: AND with a scope that is "part of the question" (A), or a precision-first pass relied on without running the coverage reaction 1.10 already required for reports and decisions (B). It measures the risk the ambiguity left open, not what every 1.10-conformant agent would do.
strategy_versions.conformant_1_10: A composition a careful reader of 1.10.0 would make: the ambiguity read in the favourable direction (A), or the coverage check run and its on_failed applied by falling back to the sensitive version (B). For D, J and P it is simply what 1.10 routed to.
strategy_versions.contract_1_11: Contract 1.11.0: catalog with roles, facet roles, scope_roles (population_defining vs applicability), catalog_check, coverage_check.unit and adaptation.if_pearls_lost.
strategy_versions.forbidden_1_11: A composition that 1.11 explicitly forbids, run to show the loss the rule prevents.
strategy_versions.forbidden_1_14_1: A composition that 1.14.1 explicitly forbids (evidence_landscape_policy.condition_guideline_pass: a guideline lane restricted to the intervention), run to show the loss the rule prevents.

unnecessary_activation: A pass in the claim unit that ANDs a population_setting or editorial filter for a facet whose expected role is not core.

cases.question: ¿Qué tratamiento de rescate usar en España tras fracaso de la triple terapia con claritromicina (OCA)?
cases.tests: Scope that conditions applicability, not population (scope_roles.applicability).

facets.facet: H. pylori after failed triple therapy

reference.note: Mori et al. 2025: 13 RCTs of second-line therapy after failure of standard triple therapy. 11 resolved; Kawai 2006 (abstract only) and Hung 2015 have no linked citation. Fits rescue after triple therapy; it is not specific to Spain (one Spanish trial, Gisbert 2007).

risk_under_1_10.purpose: efficacy, scope ANDed as part of the question

conformant_1_10.purpose: efficacy; "part of the question" read as not restricting the efficacy core

cases.question: ¿Qué evidencia hay sobre retirar benzodiacepinas en personas mayores?
cases.tests: A concept filter outside the registry (concept role) and a specific filter that replaces the core (coverage_check.replacing_pass).

reference.note: McEvoy et al. 2025: 17 reports of 16 studies of patient-directed deprescribing interventions. The list is in a supplement the full text does not carry; these 8 are the ones identifiable from the text (EMPOWER, its hospital and pharmacist variants, Kuntz, Navy, the UK GP letter) plus two identified by Codex's review.

risk_under_1_10.purpose: therapy, precision first (registry has no deprescribing filter)

conformant_1_10.purpose: therapy after coverage_check failed and on_failed applied: fallback to the sensitive version

contract_1_11.purpose: deprescribing as a concept: agent vocabulary OR the catalog filter

cases.question: ¿Aumentan las fluoroquinolonas el riesgo de aneurisma o disección aórtica?
cases.tests: Harm routed through harm filters, not a therapy filter; patient-safety filters out of the drug-safety route.

reference.note: Chen et al. 2022: 13 observational studies, search to March 2022. All 13 resolved.

contract_1_11.purpose: routing.safety fallback, run in parallel in this plan; its cost is that of this manual plan

forbidden_1_11.purpose: harm routed as a therapy question

cases.question: Soy médico de familia: ¿reducen los iSGLT2 hospitalizaciones o muerte en insuficiencia cardiaca?
cases.tests: Negative control: who asks is context, not scope.

reference.note: Vaduganathan et al. 2022 (Lancet): five trials named in its abstract, PMIDs resolved and read by Codex on 2026-10-16. The question is heart failure in general; the original Phase 0 reference cited mostly other studies.

conformant_1_10.purpose: therapy; primary_care_policy already said the asker is not a constraint

forbidden_1_11.purpose: the asker's setting ANDed into the core

cases.question: ¿Cuál es la prevalencia de obesidad infantil (2-13 años) en España?
cases.tests: Positive control: geography that DEFINES the population is core (scope_roles.population_defining). Three of the included studies are multinational with Spanish data.

reference.note: Systematic review of 13 representative studies of Spanish children, 1999-2021. 11 resolved; García-García 2013 has no linked citation and the linked Wijnhoven record is the 2013 COSI report, not the 2014 one in the table, so it is left out.

conformant_1_10.purpose: Spain ANDed as part of the question

forbidden_1_11.purpose: population-defining geography treated as a mere lane (core left unrestricted)

cases.question: ¿Son útiles los relajantes musculares en la lumbalgia aguda mecánica?
cases.tests: What each order hides by age, and the guideline lane at the level of the condition (1.14.1: reading_and_drilldown.order_hides_by_age, evidence_landscape_policy.condition_guideline_pass). Unlike the other cases the reference is recent: two records of September 2026 that an audited answer missed although both were retrievable. Its contract_1_11 guideline pass applies condition_guideline_pass, which 1.11 did not state.

reference.note: Audit of 2026-10-26 of an answer produced under the project instructions 26- (r2). 42799684: Skelly et al. 2026, the systematic review behind the guideline, inside the synthesis pass. 42687437: the multidisciplinary guideline of September 2026, which recommends muscle relaxants without naming them in its title or abstract, so it is outside the core by construction (checked by UID). Both abstracts read with pubmed_fetch_exact on 2026-10-26. Topic lbp_muscle_relaxants is the audited core byte for byte (SHA-256 95730b6f...); lbp_acute is the guideline pass of the reproduction. Not a list of everything the answer should have used.

contract_1_11.purpose: guidelines at the level of the condition, without the intervention (condition_guideline_pass)

forbidden_1_14_1.purpose: guideline lane restricted to the intervention, which 1.14.1 forbids
